title: Refunds: monthly plans
text: Refunds for monthly plans are processed within 5 business days of approval. The money returns to the original payment method.

title: Refunds: annual plans
text: Annual plans can be refunded in full within 30 days of purchase. After 30 days, refunds are prorated for the unused months.

title: Refunds: hardware
text: Hardware purchases (Lumen Hub devices) can be returned within 14 days if unopened. Opened devices are refunded minus a 15% restocking fee.

title: Chargebacks
text: If a customer opens a chargeback with their bank, the account is suspended until the dispute is resolved. Disputes are normally resolved within 45 days.

title: Support tiers
text: Premium plans include priority support with a 1-hour first response time. Standard plans receive email support with a 24-hour first response time.

title: Support hours
text: Support is available 24/7 for Premium customers. Standard support operates Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm UTC.

title: Password policy
text: Passwords must be at least 12 characters long and include one number and one symbol. Passwords expire every 180 days.

title: Two-factor authentication
text: Two-factor authentication is mandatory for all admin accounts. Supported methods are authenticator apps and hardware keys; SMS codes are not supported.

title: Data retention
text: Deleted files are kept in the trash for 30 days before permanent deletion. Backups are retained for 90 days.

title: Storage limits
text: The Free plan includes 5 GB of storage. The Standard plan includes 2 TB and the Premium plan includes 10 TB.

title: Pricing
text: The Standard plan costs $12 per user per month. The Premium plan costs $25 per user per month. Annual billing gives a 20% discount.

title: API rate limits
text: The API allows 100 requests per minute on the Free plan and 1,000 requests per minute on paid plans. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP status 429.

title: API authentication
text: API requests are authenticated with bearer tokens. Tokens expire after 24 hours and can be renewed with the refresh endpoint.

title: Uptime guarantee
text: Lumen guarantees 99.9% monthly uptime for paid plans. If uptime falls below that, customers receive a service credit of 10% of the monthly fee.

title: Service credits
text: Service credits must be requested within 30 days of the incident by contacting support. Credits are applied to the next invoice and are not paid out as cash.

title: Data regions
text: Data can be stored in three regions: US-East, EU-Central, and Asia-Pacific. The region is chosen when the account is created and cannot be changed later.

title: Encryption
text: All data is encrypted with AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. Customers on the Premium plan can supply their own encryption keys.

title: Sharing links
text: Files can be shared by link or by inviting users. Links can be set to expire after 1, 7, or 30 days.

title: Minimum team size
text: The Standard plan requires a minimum of 3 users. The Premium plan requires a minimum of 10 users.

title: Cancellation
text: Subscriptions can be cancelled at any time from the Billing page. Access continues until the end of the paid period, and no partial-month refunds are given for monthly plans.

title: Account deletion
text: When an account is deleted, all data is permanently removed within 14 days. Deleted accounts cannot be restored.

title: Invoices and payment terms
text: Invoices are emailed on the 1st of each month. Payment is due within 15 days; accounts more than 15 days overdue are downgraded to read-only.

title: Payment methods
text: Lumen accepts Visa, Mastercard, and American Express. Bank transfers are available only for annual Premium plans.

title: Mobile app
text: The mobile app is available for iOS 16 and later and Android 11 and later. Offline access requires a Standard or Premium plan.

title: Version history
text: Version history keeps previous versions of a file for 30 days on Standard plans and 180 days on Premium plans.

title: Audit logs
text: Audit logs record sign-ins, file shares, and permission changes. Logs are available on the Premium plan and are retained for 365 days.

title: Single sign-on
text: Single sign-on via SAML 2.0 is available on the Premium plan only. Setup requires an admin account and a verified domain.

title: Free trial
text: New customers get a 14-day free trial of the Premium plan. No credit card is needed to start the trial.

title: About Lumen
text: Lumen was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Lisbon, Portugal. The company has about 400 employees.

title: File size limits
text: The maximum file size is 5 GB on the Free plan and 250 GB on paid plans. Larger files must be split before uploading.

title: System status
text: Real-time system status is published at status.lumen.example. Incidents are posted within 15 minutes of detection.
